field.name: distance_weight
field.help: How heavily the system favours experts who are geographically close to the requester. 0 = ignore distance, 1 = maximum weight.

field.name: reputation_weight
field.help: How heavily the system favours experts with high reputation scores. 0 = ignore reputation, 1 = maximum weight.

field.name: online_bonus
field.help: Bonus points added to experts who are currently online.

field.name: available_bonus
field.help: Bonus points added to experts who are not currently in another session.

field.name: max_distance_km
field.help: Maximum distance (in km) within which experts will be considered. Experts further away are excluded.

field.name: reputation_threshold
field.help: Reputation points required before an expert can appear in search results.

field.name: geocoding_provider
field.help: Service used to convert addresses into coordinates.

field.name: geocoding_api_key
field.help: API key for the selected geocoding provider.

field.name: platform_fee_percent
field.help: Percentage of each session's cost that NETTRADES retains as a platform fee.

field.name: default_field_id
field.help: If the system cannot determine which professional field a question belongs to, it will use this field as the default.
